text_block_list.text:
Growing increasingly anxious over the 
managed education program, the Umamusume, 
together with Taiki Shuttle, went to 
negotiate directly with Acting Director 
Kashimoto.

Acting Principal Kashimoto then promised 
that if they competed against her team in 
the Aoharu Cup and took 1st place, she 
would grant their request.

Acting Chairwoman Kashimoto then formed an 
elite team centered around Bitter Glacée 
and Little Cocon, who fully embraced her 
philosophy of absolute management.

With the freedom of Tracen Academy on the 
line, the Trainer scrambled to gather team 
members.
